PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Flora's clue ("She was the only person beside the water. She was in a corner of her area."). So Flora (F) must be at row 4, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Dora were at row 5, column 2: then Edith's clue ("She was exactly one column west of Dora.") could not be true. So Dora can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Dora: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 6, column 7. So nobody else can stand at row 6, column 7, or Dora would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Suppose Albert were at row 2, column 2: then Dora's clue ("She was exactly three rows south of Albert.") could not be true. So Albert can't be there. All of Bruno's squares are in column 5, so nobody else can use it. Using Albert's clue ("He was alone in the Orchard."), some squares are ruled out for Edith. Edith's own clue ("She was exactly one column west of Dora. She was in a corner of her area.") rules out more squares. So Edith (E) must be at row 7, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: The murderer must be in Vivian's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Vivian.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Only one square of column 2 is still open to anyone (row 6, column 2). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use row 6. Using Edith's clue ("She was exactly one column west of Dora."), some squares are ruled out for Dora. So Dora (D) must be at row 5, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Using Dora's clue ("She was exactly three rows south of Albert."), some squares are ruled out for Albert. So Albert (A) must be at row 2, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: Bruno is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Bruno (B) must be at row 3, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: The murderer must be in Vivian's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Vivian. So Vivian (the victim) must be at row 1, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Cedric that fits his clue ("He was not standing in a puddle."). So Cedric (C) must be at row 6, column 2. Cross out his row and column. Flora is the only person in the Duck Pond with Vivian, so Flora is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_6: The Victim. She was alone with the murderer.
